environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image on AWS Lambda (on-demand, no provisioned concurrency) behind API Gateway with default throttling. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection via RDS Proxy (pgbouncer mode, transaction pooling). Database role 'app_svc_readonly_047' was provisioned by Terraform module 'rds-iam-roles' v2.3.1 with policy_template='analytics_consumer' which grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_svc_readonly_047; no additional privileges. The role has no membership in any other role. pg_hba.conf entry restricts this role to the Lambda security group CIDR only.

config.db_permissions: SELECT ONLY on public schema tables
